topic: Bruise (neel): ek chot ke baad 14 din mein rang kyun badalta hai
why_this_topic: Same format as blister: cause -> damage -> body response -> time jumps with DAY counter. Bruise gives a natural colour change per day (red, purple, green, yellow) so DAY counter carries the story; same skin cross-section, same immune cells.
hook_formula: visual-only: rewind icon then ball hits skin; on-screen 1-2 word pixel hook 'OUCH' at 0.5 s; voice sting 'Hmm'
text: Hmm? Aapko chot lagi, ab andar kya hota hai? Das din.

facts.claim: Day 1: red/dark red, blood from broken capillaries pools in tissue
purple/blue as oxygen leaves the trapped haemoglobin
most bruises fade in about two weeks
colour-by-day is a rough guide, varies by person and depth (Wikipedia warns against exact dating)
